q: In Ezekiel, what was the valley the Spirit set Ezekiel down in full of?
quote: and set me down in the middle of the valley, and it was full of bones.

q: In Ezekiel's valley of dry bones, what did God ask him?
quote: Son of man, can these bones come to life?

q: As Ezekiel prophesied to the dry bones, what did they do?
quote: there was suddenly a noise, a rattling, and the bones came together, bone to bone.

q: When breath entered the dry bones Ezekiel saw, what did they become?
quote: and they came to life and stood on their feet—a vast army.

q: In Ezekiel, God promises to replace a heart of stone with a heart of what?
quote: I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.

q: In Ezekiel, how did the scroll God gave Ezekiel to eat taste?
quote: So I ate, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth.

q: In Ezekiel, what does God say He Himself will search for?
quote: Behold, I Myself will search for My flock and seek them out.

q: In Ezekiel's vision, which face did each living creature NOT have?
why: They also had an ox's face.
quote: The form of their faces was that of a man, and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and also the face of an eagle.

q: In Ezekiel, what did God tell Ezekiel to eat before speaking to Israel?
quote: Eat this scroll, then go and speak to the house of Israel.

q: In Ezekiel, what did God make Ezekiel for the house of Israel?
quote: Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel.

q: In Ezekiel's valley vision, from where was the breath to come?
quote: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe into these slain, so that they may live!

q: In Ezekiel, God takes no pleasure in anyone's death, so what does He urge?
In Ezekiel's vision, what happens wherever the river from the temple flows?
quote: so wherever the river flows, everything will flourish.

q: In Ezekiel, God searched for a man to stand where for the land?
quote: I searched for a man among them to repair the wall and stand in the gap before Me
the word of the LORD came directly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi

q: By which river was Ezekiel among the exiles when he saw visions of God?
why: It was in the land of the Chaldeans.
quote: while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar, the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.

q: At the end of Ezekiel, what will the city's new name be?
quote: and from that day on the name of the city will be: THE LORD IS THERE.

q: In Ezekiel, for how many days did Ezekiel lie on his left side for Israel?
why: A day for each year of iniquity.
quote: For I have assigned to you 390 days, according to the number of years of their iniquity.

q: In Ezekiel, what words were written on both sides of the scroll?
quote: And written on the front and back of it were words of lamentation, mourning, and woe.
